name: 04101 · Portland, ME
findings: ZIP 04101 (Portland) has 307 nonprofit organizations. 104 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 87 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04101 (Portland) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 04101 (Portland) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 49 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
